name: 3. 7-8-9 endgame: the wrong side of the 8 makes the 9 hard

expected.why: Several shots on the 7 (bottom side pocket) leave the 8 green. Some of those leave the cue ball where the 8 is easy (model make 9/12) but no plain stroke on the 8 then leaves the 9 better than red (trap: strength 2 with draw). Others (strength 5, center) leave the 8 green and a plain stroke on the 8 that leaves the 9 green. Expected: the recommended shot on the 7 ends where some plain makeable (>= 60%) shot on the 8 leaves the 9 green.
